arnav.name: Arnav Maheshwari
arnav.quote: “When students, educators, and partner institutions across 25 countries collaborate around a shared standard of clarity, open knowledge turns into genuine local opportunity.”
arnav.bio: As Co-Founder of The Open Economics Project, Arnav oversees institutional partnerships, international chapter expansion, and organizational governance. He works closely with regional ambassadors, schools, and community organizations to turn open digital content into local educational impact.

akarsh.name: Akarsh Malavalli
akarsh.quote: “Economic understanding shouldn’t be gated by school resources. We’re building open course modules, interactive visual simulators, and local chapters that help students reason through real-world mechanisms.”
akarsh.bio: As Co-Founder of The Open Economics Project, Akarsh leads curriculum architecture across AP, IB, and A-Level pathways, alongside the design of interactive learning tools such as Graph Lab and Olympiad Studio. His work focuses on combining academic precision with intuitive visual pedagogy.
